data.content_ref: inline:The problem defines 'fair' explicitly as a bound on counts within two standard deviations of 10000/6 and requires simulating the exact recurrence to tally counts. SRC_001 instead rests its 'likely UNFAIR' verdict entirely on full-period residue-class imbalance (2^31 mod 6 = 2), which is the wrong layer of analysis for this finite-horizon, two-sigma fairness test. The target's own countercondition concedes that if the trajectory corrects the bias the generator may be fair, yet it offers no recurrence-based estimate of the realized counts; the structural full-period argument does not entail that any 10000-term window exceeds two standard deviations, so as stated it does not answer the posed question.
